faq_1_q: Do you provide after-sales service to the field?
faq_1_a: Yes, our mechanics are ready to come directly to your field location to perform service or repairs if there is a machine issue during harvest season.
faq_2_q: How is the availability of Lovol spare parts?
faq_2_a: As an official dealer, we guarantee the availability of genuine parts for all types of Combine Harvesters and Tractors that we sell.
faq_3_q: Is it possible to purchase on credit/installment?
faq_3_a: Yes, we offer both cash and credit purchase options through financing institutions that partner with us. Contact our team for more information.
faq_4_q: How long is the warranty for purchased machines?
faq_4_a: Every unit we sell comes with an official Lovol warranty. Details on the warranty period can be confirmed directly with our sales team.

combine_hero_title: A New Standard in Harvest Efficiency
combine_hero_desc: Designed for sustainable productivity with best-in-class technology and durability.
combine_spec_title: Key Specifications of the Lovol RG108 Plus
combine_feat_1: ✔ HST 56cc Transmission (Italy Interpump), speed increased 25% up to ±2.41 m/s, smoother and more powerful traction.
combine_feat_2: ✔ Header Width 2,200 mm, facilitates the harvesting process and grain intake
combine_feat_3: ✔ Threshing System 2,050 mm, equipped with 3 Ultra-Clean blowers and 4 sieve adjustments for cleaner results.
combine_feat_4: ✔ Wide Crawler 500/550 mm, low ground pressure (±17.5 kPa), stable in muddy fields and deep paddies.
combine_feat_5: ✔ Sturdy Construction & Quality Spare Parts, using components such as NSK, Bando, Bridgestone, and Carlisle for high durability.
combine_adv_1_desc: Wide header and optimal feeding system make the harvest process quicker and maximize output.
combine_adv_2_desc: Uses crawler (track) with low ground pressure, stable in waterlogged paddies and doesn't easily get stuck.
combine_adv_3_desc: Modern threshing system and blowers help minimize harvest loss and improve grain quality.
